entry.title: Söyembikä Tower
entry.note: Exact-QID mapped wall axes orient the long lower passage facade approximately west/east. The documented 1.98 m NE lean is transformed from geographic east/north into this local frame; the nearly symmetric gate elevations do not require a half-turn distinction. The OSM polygon is wider than the published 140 square metre tower footprint, apparently including lower projections. The authored square shaft is not stretched to that polygon; its center and ground contact need the placement view review. The decorative gate winter-solstice statement is not used as a measured shaft azimuth. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
